skill.summary: 用 AI 工具（豆包/Kimi/ChatGPT）搜索问题并将结果整理保存为 Obsidian 文档。触发场景：(1) 用户要求用 AI 搜索问题 (2) 用户要求浏览器搜索并保存到 Obsidian (3) 用户说"帮我查一下"并提到保存到笔记/文档/Obsidian

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Enables automated saving of AI-researched content to Obsidian.

- Supports AI search using Doubao, Kimi, and ChatGPT based on query type and language.
- Organizes and reformats search results into structured Obsidian Markdown documents.
- Automates file creation with YAML frontmatter, title, tags, and formatted content.
- Streamlines saving documents to the correct local or iCloud Obsidian vault.
- Includes built-in guidance for workflow steps and best practices.
